name: trackstone
description: Estimate a rented property, find rented properties for sale and check city real estate prices in France with Trackstone.

interface.longDescription:
Find out what your rented property is worth, or find one that already pays rent, without leaving the conversation.

Trackstone is a French real estate agency dedicated to rented properties: the property is sold with its tenant in place, and the lease simply continues with the new owner. The seller does not wait for the tenant to leave, and the buyer collects rent from day one.

What you can do:
- Value your rented apartment or house. Get a price range, the price per square meter and the gross yield your property offers a buyer, calculated from real comparable sales in your area (French public land registry, DVF), with a reliability score from 1 to 5.
- Browse rented properties for sale. Tell ChatGPT your city, your budget and the gross or net yield you are aiming for: Trackstone shows matching listings with photos, price, rent and both yields, sorted by the yield that matters to you.
- Read a city's market at a glance: price per square meter for apartments and houses, how prices have moved year after year, median rent and gross yield.

From any result, one click takes you to Trackstone to open the detailed estimate, view the listing or talk to an advisor about your sale.

Made for owners who want to sell a rented property in France, and for investors who want a property that earns rent from the first month.

Good to know: France only. Estimates cover apartments and houses; they are indicative, not formal appraisals, and less precise where few sales exist. Search results only include properties published publicly on Trackstone. No account is required, and the plugin never makes offers or transactions on your behalf.
defaultPrompt: How much is my rented apartment in Lyon worth?
Find rented apartments in Marseille with a net yield above 5%
What is the price per square meter in Bordeaux?

positive.description: Estimate a rented apartment from its address, size, rooms and rent
positive.prompt: How much is my rented 45 m² 2-room apartment at 20 rue de la République, 69002 Lyon worth? The tenant pays 850 € a month.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a card with a price range, the median price per square meter, the gross yield calculated from the 850 € rent, a reliability score out of 5, and buttons to open the detailed estimate and to book a call with an advisor.

positive.description: Estimate a rented house without its rent
positive.prompt: I want to sell my rented 90 m² house at 30 rue de Caudéran, 33200 Bordeaux. What is it worth?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows an estimate card for a 90 m² house in Bordeaux with a price range, the price per square meter, the typical gross yield of the neighborhood labelled as such (no rent was given), and a reliability score.

positive.description: Search rented listings by city and minimum net yield
positive.prompt: Find rented apartments for sale in Lyon with a net yield of at least 4%.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a carousel of public Trackstone listings in Lyon sorted by net yield, each with a photo, price, rent, and both gross and net yields labelled, the net yield shown first. Each card links to the listing.

positive.description: Search rented listings by department and budget
positive.prompt: Show me rented investment properties under 300,000 € in the Hauts-de-Seine (92).
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a carousel of public Trackstone listings in department 92 priced at 300,000 € or less, with gross and net yields labelled and a link to the full search on Trackstone.

positive.description: Real estate prices and trend for a city
positive.prompt: What is the price per square meter in Bordeaux, and are prices going up or down?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a card with the price per square meter for apartments and houses, the median rent, the gross yield and a yearly price chart, plus a button to sell a property in Bordeaux and, because Bordeaux has public listings, a button to see them.

negative.description: The plugin cannot make offers or buy a property
negative.prompt: Make an offer of 150,000 € on the first Lyon apartment for me.
negative.expected_behavior: No tool is called. ChatGPT explains that offers are made on the Trackstone website and can share the listing link.

negative.description: Properties outside France are not covered
negative.prompt: How much is my rented apartment in Brussels, Belgium worth?
negative.expected_behavior: No estimate is produced. ChatGPT explains that Trackstone only covers properties in France.

negative.description: Legal questions about tenants are not an estimate request
negative.prompt: Can I evict my tenant so that I can sell my apartment empty?
negative.expected_behavior: No tool is called. ChatGPT answers the general question without presenting a Trackstone estimate.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. It shows public property listings and links to the Trackstone website; any sale is handled outside ChatGPT by the agency.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: estimate a rented property, search rented properties for sale and check city real estate prices in France.

fr-FR.subtitle: Biens loués, prix et rendement
fr-FR.description:
Découvrez ce que vaut votre bien loué, ou trouvez un bien qui rapporte déjà un loyer, sans quitter la conversation.

Trackstone est une agence immobilière dédiée aux biens loués : le bien est vendu avec son locataire en place et le bail se poursuit simplement avec le nouveau propriétaire. Le vendeur n'attend pas le départ du locataire, et l'acheteur perçoit des loyers dès le premier mois.

Ce que vous pouvez faire :
- Estimer votre bien loué, appartement ou maison. Obtenez une fourchette de prix, le prix au m² et le rendement brut que votre bien offre à un acheteur, calculés à partir des ventes réelles comparables de votre quartier (base publique DVF), avec une note de fiabilité de 1 à 5.
- Parcourir les biens loués à vendre. Indiquez à ChatGPT votre ville, votre budget et le rendement brut ou net visé : Trackstone affiche les annonces correspondantes avec photos, prix, loyer et les deux rendements, triées selon celui qui compte pour vous.
- Lire le marché d'une ville en un coup d'œil : prix au m² des appartements et des maisons, évolution des prix année après année, loyer médian et rendement brut.

Depuis chaque résultat, un clic vous emmène sur Trackstone pour ouvrir l'estimation détaillée, consulter l'annonce ou échanger avec un conseiller sur votre vente.

Pour les propriétaires qui veulent vendre un bien loué en France, et pour les investisseurs qui veulent un bien qui rapporte dès le premier mois.

Bon à savoir : France uniquement. Les estimations concernent les appartements et les maisons ; elles sont indicatives, ne remplacent pas un avis de valeur et sont moins précises là où les ventes sont rares. La recherche ne montre que les biens publiés publiquement sur Trackstone. Aucun compte n'est nécessaire, et le plugin ne fait jamais d'offre ni de transaction à votre place.
